scope: P2 shared durable attempt budget for sensitive account security operations.
implemented: Password change, email change, MFA setup/confirmation/recovery/disable and verified session revocation share the same durable per-account five-attempt/five-minute budget.
The repository reservation is transactional and therefore applies across server instances instead of relying on process-local counters.
Switching between sensitive endpoints cannot bypass the shared account budget.
Handlers return the fixed MFA_RATE_LIMITED response shape and do not expose credentials, secrets or provider errors.
Anonymous forgot/reset flows retain their separate per-IP limits and reset-token single-use/expiry controls because an invalid anonymous token has no safe account identity to charge.
remaining: Exercise the shared budget against two concurrently running server instances backed by the deployment database.
Verify Retry-After/error presentation through independent web and installed Windows clients.
release: Source and automated fixtures only; no commit, push, merge, deployment or Windows update was performed.
